h1: Does the Holy Bible app cost money to use?
title_lead: Does the Holy Bible app cost money?
meta_description: Learn about the costs associated with Bible apps. Peace Be Still offers a clear path for your daily scripture reading and nightly prayer practice.
direct_answer: The Holy Bible app is a digital tool that provides access to scripture. While many versions are free to download, some apps include optional paid subscriptions for extra features. Peace Be Still provides a clear, simple structure with a free lane and a paid lane for those who choose it.

sections.heading: Understanding how Bible apps work
paragraphs: Many people look for a way to read the word of God on their phones. You might wonder if these tools require a payment. Some apps are funded by donations, while others use a subscription model. It is helpful to know what you are getting before you start your daily practice. Peace Be Still is built to be a quiet place for your morning and evening routine. We believe in being plain about how our app functions. You will find a free lane that is always available. If you choose to support the work, there is a paid lane. We do not use trials that turn into surprise charges. We do not show ads that interrupt your time in the word.

When you open the app, you can read the King James Version or listen to whispered Psalms. You might also use our AI Bible chat, which is clearly marked as AI. It quotes scripture word for word. We also offer Bible stories told in a Black church voice in Hush Harbor. For our Spanish-speaking families, Mi Refugio provides the Reina-Valera 1909. Our goal is to help you stay in the word without confusion.
bullets: A free lane is always available.
No trials that lead to surprise charges.
Clear options for your monthly or yearly support.

sections.heading: Finding a quiet space for scripture
paragraphs: Your time with the Bible should be unhurried. Whether you are waking up or preparing for rest, the app should be a companion. We focus on the text of the King James Version. "Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path" (Psalm 119:105). This is the foundation of our work. We do not want you to worry about hidden fees. We want you to focus on the verses. You can read or listen at your own pace. The sleep timer helps you settle into your nightly practice. You are in control of your experience at all times.

We also provide Mi Refugio for those who prefer the Reina-Valera 1909. "Jehová es mi pastor; nada me faltará" (Salmos 23:1). This allows families to share scripture in their own language. Every feature is designed to keep the focus on the Bible. We keep the interface plain and simple. You will not find clutter or complex menus here. Just the word, the prayer, and the quiet.

sections.heading: Comparing different Bible app models
paragraphs: You may have seen other apps like the Creed Bible app, the Duomo Bible app, or the Haven Bible app. Each one has its own way of operating. Some rely on a free model, while others ask for a subscription. It is common to ask: Is the Creed Bible app free? What its listing says · Peace Be Still. Similarly, you might ask: Is the Duomo Bible app free? What its listing says · Peace Be Still. Or perhaps: Is the Haven Bible app free? What its listing says · Peace Be Still. We encourage you to look at the details of any app you download.

Peace Be Still is different because we value transparency. We do not hide our costs. We do not use gimmicks to keep you subscribed. You choose the path that fits your life. If you want to use the free lane, you are welcome. If you want to support the development of the app, you can choose the paid lane. We are here to serve your need for scripture.

sections.heading: Your daily practice with Peace Be Still
paragraphs: The rhythm of your day matters. Starting with a prayer or a declaration can set a tone of peace. Ending the day with whispered Psalms can help you let go of the day's burdens. We provide the tools to make this a habit. You can use the Bible chat to ask questions. It will quote the King James Version for you. You can listen to Bible stories told in a Black church voice in Hush Harbor. These stories bring the history of the faith to life in a way that feels personal.

We are working hard to bring this to your phone. Look for Peace Be Still in the App Store and Google Play. We want to be a part of your journey. We want to help you keep the word close at all times. Whether you are at home or on the go, the Bible is there. We invite you to join us in this practice. Keep your heart open to the truth of scripture.

faq.q: Is there a free version of the app?
faq.a: Yes, there is a free lane that is always available. You can use this to read the Bible and engage with the features without any cost. We believe everyone should have access to the word of God.

faq.q: Will I be charged after a free trial?
faq.a: We do not offer free trials. This means you will never face a surprise charge after a trial period ends. You choose to pay only when you are ready to use the paid lane.

faq.q: Are there advertisements in the app?
faq.a: No, there are no ads in the app. We want your time in the Bible to be free from distractions. You can focus entirely on the scripture and your prayer practice.

faq.q: How do I get the app?
faq.a: You can look for Peace Be Still in the App Store and Google Play. We are working to make it available for everyone. Please check the stores to see if it is ready for your device.

facts.claim: The Peace Be Still app offers a free lane and a paid lane at $7.99 a month or $39.99 a year.
The King James Version of the Bible is in the public domain in most countries.
